name: D · 青蝶沉静
summary: 窄翼直襟 · 长短叠片 · 沉稳内敛
detail: DEEP BLUE BLACK smooth straight hair to collarbone, crisp horizontal fringe, tucked sides and one long simple pale-jade horizontal hairpin ending in a tiny oval loop, no horn crown/braid/ponytail. A subtly long rounded face with blunt chin, low level brows, very calm narrow half-open graphic eyes and almost neutral thoughtful mouth. Moon ivory/slate blue/deep jade with one small muted bronze accent. BUTTERFLY SLENDER FOLDED WINGS: a tailored high diagonal Chinese collar jacket fitted over fuller bust and a modest narrow sash, two close hanging long narrow outer robe panels with smooth gently pointed butterfly wing ends at lower calf, one shorter contrasting inner wing panel to knee. Long narrow sleeves, no huge fan sleeves. Broad slate-blue wing-edge band and only TWO large pale triangular vein divisions, no ornamental moons/stars/cloud curls or elaborate repeated trigrams. Charcoal slim pants and simple slate boots visible under open panels. Quiet upright slight contrapposto, arms bent LOW at waist holding a SMALL bronze Taoist compass disc with both hands naturally supported, center simple yin-yang and eight broad sectors but no tiny writing. Two short pale-blue waist ties only. Restrained narrow vertical silhouette clearly different from other three.
